observations.title: Three bounded business notifications reached the approved development Inbox, one each
steps: Approved recipient was compared privately with the existing browser mailbox; it matched. Connected Gmail MCP account did not match and was not used as delivery evidence.

One exact subject/date search across all folders returned exactly three conversations, each bearing Inbox label: application approved, application declined and meal cancelled, at01:46 BST23October. Opening each showed one notification and the expected non-sensitive template text.

Approved and cancelled notifications link the same synthetic meal; declined links its separate synthetic meal. Links use the configured local development origin, not a production deployment. No link followed, extra send or resending occurred.

This proves the observed three-message delivery/no-duplicate sample only. It does not prove signed webhook processing, deleted-account templates, full channel/recipient matrix, or production links. G-MAIL remains BLOCKED.

observations.executedBy: Codex QA; development environment owner independently checked public DNS
observations.title: QA-F65 missing DMARC policy: receiver UI reports FAIL despite passing SPF and DKIM
steps: All three actual original-message views show SPF PASS and DKIM PASS for mail.fancyabite.uk, but DMARC FAIL; Authentication-Results contains no dmarc result. Preserve this exact observation, not an inferred alignment failure.

Public domains only: visible From domain mail.fancyabite.uk; passing DKIM d=mail.fancyabite.uk plus amazonses.com; smtp.mailfrom domain rsend.mail.fancyabite.uk. Passing DKIM exactly aligns with From.

Environment owner queried authoritative DNS: both organizational and sending-subdomain DMARC names returned authoritative NXDOMAIN. Concrete gap is unpublished DMARC policy and no DMARC PASS evidence.

Minimal proposed change is sending-subdomain-only monitoring policy; not executed. No new report recipient, quarantine/reject/root-domain policy or fourth email was approved or executed. Exact scoped approval and a fresh bounded verification send are needed before closure.
observations.classification: confirmed environment configuration gap; no demonstrated DKIM alignment failure
